mcp:tool-listener.doc:name: MCP Server - Tool Listener
mcp:tool-listener.name: get-campaign-details
mcp:tool-listener.mcp:description:
This tool retrieves all currently active Salesforce Campaigns.
IMPORTANT TOOL USAGE RULE: This tool must be called BEFORE the send-bulk-retention-email tool whenever the user wants to send retention emails.
If multiple active campaigns are returned, the agent must: 1. Present the campaigns to the user. 2. Show the campaign Name and Description. 3. Ask the user to select one campaign. 4. Wait for the user's selection. 5. Only after the user selects a campaign should the agent call send-bulk-retention-email.
If exactly one active campaign is returned, the agent may automatically select it.
If no active campaigns are returned, do not send any emails and inform the user that there are no active campaigns.
Never invent a campaign or campaign ID.

salesforce:query.salesforce:salesforce-query: SELECT Id, Name, IsActive, Description FROM Campaign WHERE IsActive = true

logger.doc:name: Log - Query Result
logger.message: #["[get-campaign-details-flow] Salesforce query returned " ++ (sizeOf(payload) as String) ++ " active campaigns"]
